root_cause.text: The function do_abort_log_replay() unconditionally dereferences wc->subvol_path without a NULL check, while wc->subvol_path can be NULL when btrfs_alloc_path() fails earlier in replay_one_buffer().
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "When btrfs_alloc_path() fails in replay_one_buffer(), wc->subvol_path is NULL, but btrfs_abort_log_replay() calls do_abort_log_replay() which unconditionally dereferences wc->subvol_path when attempting to print debug information." The patch adds a NULL check: `if (wc->subvol_path && wc->subvol_path->nodes[0])`.
